title: Small Two-Motor Robot Car Speed Control
summary: Small two-motor robot car modeled as a first-order voltage-to-speed drivetrain. We control forward wheel speed to 1 m/s using a common motor voltage command.
equations: tau dv/dt + v = K u + d
v is forward speed, u is motor voltage, d is load disturbance in speed units
assumptions: Both DC motors driven by a common voltage command for straight-line motion, no differential steering
Linearized around 1 m/s forward on flat ground, no wheel slip
Motor inductance and battery voltage sag neglected, first-order drivetrain dominates
Load disturbance models slope / friction / payload as equivalent input voltage
controllerRationale: PI-dominated speed loop with small filtered D for noise robustness. IMC tuning for first-order plant with closed-loop lambda ~0.4 s gives kp=tau/(K*lambda) ~2.0 and ki=kp/tau ~7.0 for ~1.8 s settling and zero steady-state error. kd small, N=20 rad/s ~5x bandwidth.
